name: Create a HubSpot task when a target account announces funding, from daily looot news searches

parameters.content:
## A HubSpot task for every funding announcement at your accounts

### How it works
1. Every day at 8, looot runs one Google News search per target account for funding words: raises, Series A to C, seed.
2. **New funding news** keeps headlines that name the account and a round, and skips links it already turned into a task.
3. Each new announcement becomes a HubSpot task on that company with the headline, the link and the source.

Fresh funding often means new budget and new hires. The task puts it in front of the account owner the same day.

Links already used are remembered in the workflow's static data, which n8n keeps only for active workflows.

**Cost per day**, from looot's public catalog on 2026-10-31: news search $0.001 per account. 50 accounts cost $0.05 a day, about $1.50 a month. Each call is capped at $0.05.

### Setup
- Needs the verified community node **n8n-nodes-looot** (built against 0.1.4): Settings > Community nodes > Install, search `looot`. [Install guide](https://docs.n8n.io/integrations/community-nodes/installation/verified-install/)
- looot: sign up at [looot.ai](https://looot.ai), top up (from $5), create an agent token under Settings > Agent tokens, then add a **looot API** credential in n8n.
- A HubSpot private app token credential with CRM objects write access.
- List your accounts and their HubSpot company IDs in **Accounts**.

### Customization
Edit the FUNDING pattern in **New funding news** to also catch acquisitions or new offices. Post to Slack as well with a Slack node after the task.

## One news search per account
Edit the list in Accounts.

## Only new funding headlines
One task per account per day at most.
